description:
modules/traegerview — GET /traeger/schools/comparison (#4715, ADR 0242): the
Träger row, the school IDs of the Träger, the school rows, the child of each
approved enrollment with the running phases, the care offering bookings of
the window, the check-ins per day, and the Träger row with the captured
Stichtagszahlen of Organisation & Tenancy (the port of GET
/traeger/schools/key-date-counts), in one administrative transaction. Flat in
the number of schools; the comparison reads no rooms.
